public_seam: server/embedded-service.mjs exports createEmbeddedService({ dataDir, scan }) and returns an instance with invoke(method, payload). The injected scan adapter returns normalized synthetic inventory records. The service owns all scan generations, profile state, and pending state transfers per instance.

criteria.text: Import and construction are inert; construction never scans or listens, never mutates BOT_CROSSING_DATA, and separate service instances retain separate profile-scoped state.
criteria.test_id: service construction is inert and owns profile state without process-global data paths

criteria.text: A synthetic scan runs only after an explicit inventory request; session creation, terminal resume, and unknown methods are rejected without scanning or state writes.
criteria.test_id: only an explicit inventory request scans; unsupported privileged operations are refused

criteria.text: A 15,000-record snapshot is served in at most 250-record pages under 1 MiB, with stable generation/cursors; cancellation invalidates the generation.
criteria.test_id: 15,000 records use bounded pages with stable generation and cursors; cancellation ends the snapshot

criteria.text: State larger than 64 KiB round-trips through bounded chunks; an incomplete/interrupted transfer commits no state and leaves the previous saved state intact.
criteria.test_id: chunked state transfer round-trips archives over 64 KiB and interrupted transfer commits nothing

criteria.text: The standalone HTTP adapter and upstream API behavior remain unchanged and pass their existing tests.
criteria.reason: This contract adds no HTTP host and does not replace existing HTTP/API tests. Run the upstream API suite after shared service extraction.

criteria.text: Private child IPC framing, sender/document-generation validation, hostile frame rejection, protocol negotiation, and native Electron channel revocation are verified on the pinned Electron runtime.
criteria.reason: Outside this synthetic service contract; requires the Rhythm receiver and pinned Electron host.

not_tested: COL-03 process ownership and packaged worker criteria
